what_this_is: One verdict per entry of rust/test_data/grammar_quality/, on the question: does this artifact hold a value DERIVED FROM THIS TREE, and if so does it carry an identity block that says which tree? The entry set is RE-DERIVED on every run by scripts/check_baseline_identity.sh; only these dispositions are written down, because a disposition is a human decision nothing can re-derive. An entry with no row FAILS, and a row naming no entry FAILS, so this list can neither be bypassed nor accumulate dead exemptions.
the_distinction_that_decides_every_row: ⭐ DERIVED FROM THE TREE is not the same as NUMERIC. A certificate total is a function of the grammar and goes stale when the grammar moves. A performance budget, a seed, a sample count or an LRM-derived legality verdict is not: it is what the run is TOLD, or what the STANDARD says. Freshness-checking the second kind would be noise, and worse, it would invite re-deriving an expectation that is supposed to hold the tree to account rather than follow it.
honest_limit: ⛔ NEITHER 'deferred' NOR 'adopted-unconfirmed' IS A CLEAN BILL OF HEALTH. 'adopted-unconfirmed' says the artifact's numbers are known NOT to describe the tree it records, so every gate calling --verify REFUSES; it buys input-drift detection and an owner, not correctness. And 'deferred' is an ACCEPTED RISK: those rows hold tree-derived expectations with nothing watching their inputs, exactly as the adopted row did before SV-CORPUS-GRAD.13c.2x found it RED for eleven grammar revisions. What this register buys is that the debt is VISIBLE, OWNED and cannot grow silently. ⚠️ And a disposition is a reading of each artifact, not a proof about it: SV-CORPUS-GRAD.13c.2x's key-name sweep sized this population at 15 and declared itself a mechanical FLOOR owing per-row adjudication. This is that adjudication, and it disagrees in both directions -- five *_v0_contract files whose 'derived' fields are all run configuration, and one .env baseline the *.json-only sweep could not see at all.

dispositions.adopted: carries an `identity` block whose expectations are CONFIRMED against the digests it records, and this enforcer re-hashes every input it declares on every run
dispositions.adopted-unconfirmed: carries an `identity` block that says, in the artifact itself, that its expectations do NOT describe the recorded tree. The digests still track movement so drift is still caught, `owner_leaf` owns the re-derivation, and every gate calling `--verify` REFUSES — so this is declared, owned debt, never a green light
dispositions.deferred: holds expectations that ARE a function of the tree, adoption is owed, and `owner_leaf` names the task leaf that owes it. An ACCEPTED RISK, not a clean bill of health — what it buys is that the debt is VISIBLE, OWNED and cannot grow silently
dispositions.not-a-derived-baseline: holds no value that is a function of the tree — schema versions, run configuration, policy budgets, case lists, human dispositions — so an identity block would guard nothing and would only add a surface to rot
dispositions.identity-native: the artifact IS an identity record — it stores digests rather than expectations — and a named doctrine already re-derives it every run. `verified_by` names that enforcer and this register checks the enforcer exists; it does NOT re-run it
dispositions.corpus-directory: a corpus tree rather than a baseline file; its contents are inputs that a baseline DECLARES, not expectations of their own

entries.reason: THE EVIDENCE CHAIN OF THIS WHOLE DOCTRINE, and the row that taught it what it was missing. SV-CORPUS-GRAD.13c.2x measured it RED at HEAD by 71 rules and 53 UNKNOWNs after ELEVEN revisions of grammars/systemverilog.ebnf. ⛔ It is `adopted-unconfirmed`, NOT `adopted`: its expected_* fields were derived on 2026-08-12 and are known NOT to describe HEAD, so a block claiming they were would be a confident wrong answer -- which is exactly what slice 1 shipped and -0249 retracted. Re-derivation is .13c.2x(c) and is HARD-BLOCKED by .13c.2x.1 (a possibly nondeterministic rule count). FIVE inputs declared: the grammar and the generated parser it certifies through, plus the three engine surfaces the counts are a function of -- grammar_wellformedness.rs (the census itself), indirect_lr_elimination.rs (which SYNTHESIZES 25 of the rules the total counts -- .13c.2x.1), and stimuli_generator.rs (whose witness pass decides the witness/UNKNOWN split -- ENGINE-UNIVERSAL-SERVICES.11 moved these very numbers by changing one depth budget there). ⚠️ rust/scripts/sv_cert_recognized_union_gate.sh is deliberately NOT an input: it ASSERTS the numbers, it does not PRODUCE them. Declaring the consumer would stale this baseline on every cosmetic edit to a 400-line shell script, and a gate that cries wolf is a gate people learn to bypass.

It stores digests, not expectations: verified_at_commit + emission_sha + a parser_sha and input_sha per family. GENERATED-REPRODUCIBILITY tier 1 re-hashes all three fields on every commit, so it is already the thing this doctrine asks the other rows to become.

⭐ THE SHARPEST SIBLING, named as such by SV-CORPUS-GRAD.13c.2x: min_total_rules=1403, min_reachable_rules=1404, max_unreachable_rules=0 and max_unreachable_branches=2 are all functions of grammars/systemverilog.ebnf, carrying the same eleven revisions of drift beneath them. ⛔ MEASURED 2026-08-20 (-0249), and it CORRECTS this row's first draft: the FLOORS are cleared comfortably (1483 defined / 1607 reachable) but max_unreachable_rules=0 is a CEILING and it is BREACHED -- `make -C rust sv_syntax_closure_gate` is RED at HEAD with unreachable_rules=3. So this baseline cannot be adopted `confirmed` either; the breach is owned by SV-CORPUS-GRAD.13c.2x.3, which measured the three rules to be PGEN's own LR-eliminator residue. ⚠️ The first draft of this row reasoned that a floor makes staleness invisible; that was true of the floors and FALSE of the file, because the same contract also carries ceilings. A row is a reading of an artifact, not a proof about it.

Same shape one family over: min_total_rules=71 / min_reachable_rules=69 / max_unreachable_rules=2 / max_unreachable_branches=24 over grammars/systemverilog_preprocessor .ebnf. Floors, so stale and green are indistinguishable without an identity block.

allowed_unreachable_rules=[] and allowed_unreachable_branches=[] are EMPTY-SET assertions over the SVPP grammar -- the strictest possible form of a derived expectation, since any grammar change that strands one rule breaks them.

expected_total=48 / expected_proof=0 / expected_witness=48 / expected_unknown=0 are exact certificate-coverage equalities over grammars/rtl_const_expr.ebnf and its generated parser -- the same object as the adopted row, on a smaller grammar.

cert.expected_total=1122 / expected_proof=329 / expected_witness=779 / expected_unknown=14 are certificate-coverage equalities over the verilog_2005 PROFILE of the SV grammar, so every SV grammar revision is a candidate to move them.

expected_totals.* (cases_executed=14, parse_pass_total=14, parse_fail_total=0, …) are exact counts produced by running the SV parser over a declared external corpus: functions of the parser AND of the corpus submodule pin.

expected_case_count=44 is the case count of rust/test_data/regex/stress_tests.json -- a derived equality over a second tracked file, which is precisely the dependency an identity `inputs` map exists to name.

⛔ THE ROW THAT PROVES THE .13c.2x CENSUS UNDERCOUNTED: it sized the population over *.json only, and this .env holds SEVEN derived expectations (EXPECTED_CASES=2189, PARSE_OK=1609, PARSE_FAIL=580, MIN_MATCH=1845, MAX_MISMATCH=344, MAX_FALSE_ACCEPT=299, MAX_FALSE_REJECT=48) over the regex grammar, its generated parser and the pcre2-10.47 case corpus. Its own header records a prior +1 of PRE-EXISTING drift found by hand. ⚠️ BLOCKED ON A CARRIER: the identity block has a JSON carrier only, so this row cannot be adopted until SV-CORPUS-GRAD.13c.2x.2 designs the .env form. Registered deferred rather than quietly excluded.

lint_policy.correctness_roster_size=68 is a function of the INSTALLED clippy (the file records clippy 0.1.95), and expected.correctness_findings_in_generated=0 is a function of every generated/*.rs. Its own `measured_at_commit: 730419a2` is a hand-written note that nothing re-hashes -- the .13i shape in prose form.
instrument_a.out_of_charter records measured_distinct_dates=24 and measured_bytes=562723 for a tracked document; both are exact functions of that document's current bytes.

calibration.facts[].expected_sentinels is GROUND TRUTH the instrument must reproduce, derived from named grammars plus the sentinel detector itself -- so a detector change can invalidate the calibration that is supposed to police it.

104 numeric leaves under samples[].expected_elaboration -- top_parameters, child_parameters, child_instance_count -- each an exact elaboration result over a tracked sample and the rtl_frontend elaborator.

lanes[].expected_signatures pins the exact break signatures the directed hunter must find for each grammar. The file's own owner_note records a signature VANISHING when the regex grammar was restructured, which is a derived expectation moving under a tree change, observed.
